items.q: And so, I had worked with these guys off and on doing little gigs. It might've -- it must've been Cedric -- because Cedric Wallace was the one who approached me about the date.

ctx.x: Right. And he was also -- oh. Well, Barksdale had been around a long time. I think at one time he played some things with Fats Waller.
And so, I had worked with these guys off and on doing little gigs. It might've -- it must've been Cedric -- because Cedric Wallace was the one who approached me about the date.
And these were Joe Davis' songs.
